errors.text_span: Графиката съдържа една синя линия с кръгли маркери.
errors.evidence: The chart displays two separate data representations: a series of scatter points (dots) and a solid, segmented line. The description incorrectly merges these into a single 'line with round markers', even though the line does not pass through all the markers.
The solid line begins at approximately 4,150,000 for the year 2018, not 4,000,000. The first data point (dot) is also visibly above 4,000,000.
The line and the final data point for the year 2022 end at a value of approximately 4,850,000, which is clearly below the stated 4,900,000.

errors.text_span: В участъка между 2020 и 2022 година нарастването става по-изразено, като линията се характеризира с по-стръмен наклон.
errors.evidence: The visual change to a steeper slope occurs around the year 2019, not 2020. The line is steeper from 2019 to 2022.

errors.text_span: В точката (2019, 4200000) линията има локален минимум
errors.evidence: The line is monotonically increasing and does not have a local minimum. The description incorrectly identifies the point where the slope changes as a minimum. Additionally, the value at 2019 is closer to 4,250,000, not 4,200,000.
The point at the end of the line in 2022 represents the global maximum for the depicted interval, not a local maximum.
